credential_policy: The pilot worker must never supply login credentials, a paid subscription, a session cookie, or any other access-control circumvention to fetch a source. A paywalled, login-gated, or bot-walled response (for example, from a newspapers.com clipping) is a valid, recorded failure for that source — not a signal to authenticate or work around the wall.
